name: MONAI Bundle (remote GPU)
description: Run a MONAI Bundle segmentation model (spleen, 104 organs, abdominal organs, pancreas, kidney, prostate, brain) on an external GPU such as Google Colab, show the labels in the ROI manager and save them as DICOM SEG. Research use only - not a diagnostic device.
author: Visionary Imaging Services, Inc.

aiTools.name: segment_models
aiTools.description: List the CT segmentation models and the organ names that can be requested (read only).

aiTools.name: segment_run
aiTools.description: Segment organs on the displayed CT series with a MONAI bundle on an external GPU and show the result in the ROI manager. The image is sent to the compute endpoint after the user approves. Research use only.

organs.description: Organ names separated by commas, Japanese or English (e.g. 脾臓, liver, 左腎臓).

aiTools.name: segment_undo
aiTools.description: Remove the segmentation result shown by segment_run.

description.ja: 臓器名を尋ね、同意のうえで外部の計算機で分割し、結果を ROI マネージャに表示して体積を示します。
description.en: Ask for organ names, segment them on the external compute endpoint after you approve, show the result in the ROI manager and report the volumes.

message.ja: 結果を表示しました。残す場合は［続ける］、取り消す場合は［ここで止める］のあと、スキル「分割結果の取り消し」を実行してください。
message.en: The result is shown. Press Continue to keep it. To remove it, press Stop here and then run the skill “Remove the segmentation result”.

description.ja: このプラグインが表示した分割結果だけを消します。
description.en: Removes only the segmentation result this plugin showed.

message.ja: 分割結果を消します。よいですか？
